test_modes.name: Internal Loop Back Mode
test_modes.purpose: Hot self-test of the M_CAN protocol stack without disturbing the connected CAN bus. m_can_rx is disconnected internally; m_can_tx is held recessive; transmitted bits are looped back to the receiver path.

test_modes.name: External Loop Back Mode
test_modes.purpose: Hardware self-test with bus participation; transmitted bits are visible at m_can_tx and looped back to the receiver. The M_CAN ignores acknowledge errors so the test is independent of external stimulation.

test_modes.name: Bus Monitoring Mode (silent listening)
test_modes.purpose: Receive valid data + remote frames; cannot transmit dominant bits — dominant ACK / error flags are rerouted internally so the bus is not disturbed; TXBRP held in reset. Used for bus traffic analysis.

test_modes.name: Tx Pin Driver Control
test_modes.purpose: TEST.TX = 00 normal; 01 Sample-Point monitoring at m_can_tx; 10 force dominant on m_can_tx; 11 force recessive on m_can_tx (production tests / DC checks).

test_modes.name: Rx Pin Monitor
test_modes.purpose: TEST.RX reflects the current m_can_rx pin value (0 = dominant, 1 = recessive); allows the CPU to verify PHY-side bus state.

test_modes.name: Restricted Operation Mode (NOT a test mode but a constrained ops mode)
test_modes.purpose: Receives data + remote frames + sends ACK; does NOT send error/data/remote/overload frames. Used for bit-rate detection on unknown CAN networks; freezes TEC + REC (CEL keeps counting).

spec_provided_observability.name: ECR.CEL[7:0]
spec_provided_observability.purpose: CAN Error Logging counter; overflows → IR.ELO.

spec_provided_observability.name: ECR.REC[6:0] / ECR.RP
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Receive Error Counter + Receive Error Passive flag.

spec_provided_observability.name: PSR.ACT[1:0]
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Module activity: sync / idle / receiver / transmitter.

spec_provided_observability.name: PSR.LEC[2:0] / PSR.DLEC[2:0]
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Last Error Code arbitration phase + data phase.

spec_provided_observability.name: PSR.PXE / RFDF / RBRS / RESI
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Protocol Exception flag + receive-side flags for last CAN FD frame.

spec_provided_observability.name: TEST.RX / TEST.TX / TEST.LBCK
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Direct CAN pin observability + Tx driver control.

spec_provided_observability.name: TXBRP / TXBTO / TXBCF
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-Buffer pending / occurred / cancellation finished bitmaps.

spec_provided_observability.name: NDAT1 / NDAT2
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 64 New-Data flags for dedicated Rx Buffers.

spec_provided_observability.name: Extension Interface
spec_provided_observability.purpose: All IR flags + selected status/control signals routed to module-external interrupt unit.

self_check_mechanisms: Monitoring — transmitters compare bit levels driven to bus levels detected (using SSP in CAN FD data phase when TDC enabled).
Cyclic Redundancy Check — 15-bit BCH for Classical; 17-bit (≤16 B) or 21-bit (>16 B) for CAN FD; ISO mode adds 4-bit stuff-count + parity.
Bit Stuffing — detect 6 consecutive identical bits = STUFF ERROR.
Message Frame Check — fixed-form fields = FORM ERROR.
Protocol Exception detection — receiver sees FDF = recessive AND res = recessive → PSR.PXE.
RAM Watchdog (RWD) — Message RAM access without READY → IR.WDI.
External ECC/Parity feedback — m_can_aeim_berr[1:0] triggers IR.BEC / IR.BEU.

error_count_thresholds.consequence: Node enters error-passive state — PSR.EP = 1 + IR.EP change. In CAN FD transmitted ESI bit forced recessive.
TX error count ≥ 256 → bus-off — PSR.BO = 1 + IR.BO change + CCCR.INIT set.

recovery_from_bus_off: After 129 occurrences of Bus_Idle (129 × 11 consecutive recessive bits) following CPU clearing CCCR.INIT, the M_CAN may rejoin as error-active. PSR.LEC updated to Bit0Error each time an 11-recessive-bit sequence is monitored.
notes: Beyond protocol-level self-checking the M_CAN provides a rich on-chip debug surface: Test Register (CAN pin control / monitor), Loop Back modes, Bus Monitoring Mode, Restricted Operation Mode, Tx FIFO / Queue status, Tx Buffer Cancellation Finished bitmap, live Error Counter Register (ECR.CEL/TEC/REC), Protocol Status Register (PSR.BO/EW/EP/ACT/LEC/DLEC/PXE/RFDF/RBRS/RESI/TDCV), and an Extension Interface routing all IR flags + selected status/control signals to a module-external interrupt unit. Debug-on-CAN uses three consecutive Rx Buffers as Debug Messages A/B/C with a DMA handoff and a 4-state DMS state machine.

interrupt_observability.30_flags_in_IR: ARA / PED / PEA / WDI / BO / EW / EP / ELO / BEU / BEC / DRX / TOO / MRAF / TSW / TEFL / TEFF / TEFW / TEFN / TFE / TCF / TC / HPM / RF1L / RF1F / RF1W / RF1N / RF0L / RF0F / RF0W / RF0N.
interrupt_observability.edge_sensitive: Each flag set on edge; W1C clears.
interrupt_observability.per_flag_enable_IE: Bit n = 1 enables interrupt source n.
interrupt_observability.line_enable_ILE: EINT0 / EINT1 enable / disable the two interrupt outputs.

debug_on_can_support.method: Three consecutive Rx Buffers used to store Debug Messages A / B / C; filter elements with SFEC/EFEC = 111.
debug_on_can_support.dma_handoff: After A+B+C stored: m_can_dma_req asserts; DMA controller reads + asserts m_can_dma_ack.
debug_on_can_support.state_machine: DMS = 00 (idle / reset) → DMS = 01 (msg A received) → DMS = 10 (A+B received) → DMS = 11 (A+B+C received → DMA req) → DMS = 00 (after DMA ack). Out-of-order receptions restart the sequence.
